annotations.title: What a vitamin, mineral or supplement does and how much adults need

description: What a vitamin, mineral or popular supplement does, how much adults need or studies used, limits, cautions and food sources. For requests like "what does magnesium glycinate do?", "what is vitamin K for?", "how much vitamin D do I need?", "is ashwagandha safe?" or "what is creatine?". Covers vitamins A, B1, B2, B5, B6, B12, C, D, E and K, niacin, folate, biotin, choline, calcium, iron, zinc, magnesium, potassium, selenium, iodine, copper, chromium, manganese, molybdenum, phosphorus, boron and omega-3, and explains common forms. Also covers creatine, melatonin, caffeine, ashwagandha, turmeric, CoQ10, collagen, protein powder, probiotics, psyllium, glucosamine, St John's wort, green tea extract, berberine, L-theanine and elderberry: for these it returns supplement, what_studies_looked_at, studied_amounts, ceiling, cautions and source instead of rda and upper_limit. Links the NIH fact sheet. With country=GB the answer gives the UK amounts and NHS supplement guidance, also in the uk field.

country.description: US, GB, IE, CA, AU. GB gives UK (NHS) amounts; also picks the shop link site. Default from the request.
